local_evidence.excerpt: Parsed YAML: 12 model keys; no aliases; capabilities.tools=true on all 12. reasoning_effort groups are [low] for qwen3.8-27b-fp8; [low, medium, xhigh] for five other Qwen3.8 lanes; [low, medium, high, xhigh] for two Muse lanes and Ornith; absent for Gemma, Laguna, and Nemotron. QWEN38_COMMON expands to --reasoning-parser qwen3 --tool-call-parser qwen3_xml --enable-auto-tool-choice. routing.router.use is matrix.
local_evidence.note: Configured serving and lifecycle authority. This is file evidence, not proof that the deployed router loaded the revision or that every backend behaves as declared.

local_evidence.excerpt: Parsed YAML: 12 model_list entries and custom_llm_provider=hosted_vllm on every entry. All model names equal their llama-swap IDs. Only qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4 and qwen3.8-27b-quasar-nvfp4 set supports_function_calling, supports_tool_choice, and supported_openai_params containing tools and tool_choice. Muse Glimmer's two entries and Nemotron set reasoning but not supports_reasoning. general_settings.store_model_in_db=true; litellm_settings.callbacks includes custom_callbacks.local_thinking_policy.
local_evidence.note: Configured client projection. The file duplicates the llama-swap catalog and enables a second DB-backed model-definition path.

local_evidence.excerpt: LocalReasoningRequestAdapter handles nine named local models. Control precedence is nested enable_thinking, top-level enable_thinking, thinking_token_budget, then reasoning_effort. Qwen3.8 aliases minimal/low to low, medium/moderate to medium, and high/xhigh/max to xhigh. NInfer keeps effort top-level; the other Qwen3.8 lanes nest it. Off aliases set enable_thinking=false and remove stale effort fields.
